entities.summary: Taras Kompanichenko (b. 1969-11-14, Kyiv) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kyiv and Ukraine. Known in the fields of ukraine, composers & musicians, europe.
